title: Research context cannot answer Ask by itself
description: A Research Question and open Gap are relevant context, but no qualifying Claim and Evidence support the requested answer. Ask must return insufficient_evidence rather than a contextual answer presented as grounded.

provenance.note: Tests the general evidence sufficiency invariant.

reviewer_notes: Derived context may qualify a grounded answer but cannot satisfy the evidence threshold.

gold_groups.rationale: This is a context record, not evidence.
